cues.voiceover: This house uses the same rainwater four times.
Rain runs off the roof, through a silt catcher, into a cistern. One inch of rain gives about two-thirds of a gallon for every square foot of roof.
cues.onScreen: 1 in of rain = 2/3 gal per sq ft

cues.voiceover: Job one: it's filtered for drinking and showers.
Job two: sink and shower water feeds an indoor planter that grows food.
Job three: that same water flushes the toilet.
Job four: it ends in an outdoor plant cell. Flowers and shrubs, not food.
Check your state's rules before you build. Follow R&B's Homesteading for more off-grid systems.
